en: Heeey, {player}! You made it! I told you I'd be here first, didn't I?
Um, you know what? There's something I want to look into here in Reversal Mountain, for Professor Juniper.
But the wild Pokémon in here are really tough, and I can't get far on my own. Could you come with me? Please?
Don't worry, I'll take care of healing our Pokémon whenever they need it. Ready? Let's go!
I'll be along in a moment, {player}. I just want to look at this rock first.
Oh! I'd like to look around a little more by myself. Shall we split up for now?
Oh! {player}! This is the place! I can feel it! Let's look around here a little.
You look like someone who keeps careful notes on the Pokémon you meet! A kindred spirit!
Show me that you know this mountain's own Pokémon. Have one of them on your team and I'll give you something useful.
Hmm, there's none of the mountain's own with you. Woobat, Boldore, Skorupi and Grumpig live here, and Excadrill too. Come back with one.
Ah! A Pokémon of this very mountain! Wonderful. Please take this.
False Swipe leaves its target with 1 HP when it would have fainted. It's a very restrained move, and perfect for catching a Pokémon.
False Swipe is a gentle move, but a very useful one. The Pokémon here are hardy. Take your time catching them.
